title: A considered balance
description: A thin allocation ring with exact shares, a central total and a compact responsive key.

props.name: data
props.description: Caller-owned { id, label, value, tone? } categories with unique, nonempty IDs. Values are finite and nonnegative. Missing values or an overflowing total suppress the full allocation. Zero entries remain in the key without sectors. Explicit tones a–d or stable identity select colors.

props.name: unitLabel
props.description: Caller-owned heading and measurement unit. Defaults to Value (Total for NocturneRing).

props.name: contextLabel
props.description: Optional caller-owned time window or reporting context.

props.name: valueFormatter
props.description: Formats exact readings and tooltips; defaults to en-US with at most two decimals. Compact plot annotations retain the full value in inspection.

props.name: width
props.description: Total width in pixels; otherwise fills the container.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels. Dense plots and keys scroll inside the frame.

props.name: animate
props.description: Finite native drawing using scoped motion tokens and live reduced-motion preference; defaults to true.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible title for the native chart.
